title: Build and qualify the first curator-to-reader collections workflow
expected_value: Enable curators to create and share secure PDF collections while preserving existing local discovery and reading workflows; adoption impact is unmeasured.
test_requirements: Verify verified-account gating, ownership, private/unlisted/public visibility, PDF upload validation/quotas, public guest access, PDF.js rendering, and responsive browser workflow; keep live-provider/deployment status distinct from mocked tests.
acceptance_criteria: Add secure collection metadata and private PDF storage architecture with public/unlisted/private visibility and server-side authorization.
Implement a responsive curator-to-guest first slice for create, upload, organize, customize, publish/share, and PDF.js read without regressing the existing local library.
Add automated security and browser tests for authentication, ownership, upload validation, permissions, rendering, and public access.
Run independent OpenAI review, local checks, and mobile browser verification; preserve production and required PR/release gates.
Document setup prerequisites, exact evidence, and unqualified/missing requirements; do not claim production readiness.
constraints: Do not deploy, apply migrations, alter production accounts/storage, or claim real provider verification. Preserve the existing reader restoration blocker and local PDF behavior. Use a review branch and exact tested-head push workflow.
next_action: Complete independent review, push the exact locally verified head, then configure the intended Supabase/Netlify environment and run real verified-account/browser qualification before any release.
